categories.main_business_segments: Shijihengtong Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three core business segments: vehicle owner information services, life information services, and business process services. The company provides comprehensive digital life services including smart parking, driving test training, ETC processing, vehicle maintenance, and content review services. It serves large enterprise clients such as financial institutions, telecom operators, internet companies, and highway groups, connecting end consumers and small merchants through a B2B2C model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary 'big middle platform + small applications' technology architecture enabling intelligent integration of merchant resources, content, and customer service. It employs big data analytics, cloud-edge collaboration, AI agent-based decision systems, federated learning for data security, and intelligent operation management systems. The firm has obtained multiple patents and software copyrights, and its technology supports real-time data management, intelligent marketing, and digital rights management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large enterprises with extensive consumer bases such as China Mobile, Tencent, China Ping An, banks, and provincial highway groups. The company serves industries like telecommunications, finance, insurance, internet services, and transportation. Its end markets focus on vehicle owners, telecom subscribers, and consumers seeking digital lifestyle services across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guiyang, Guizhou Province, and subsidiaries across multiple provinces including Shanxi, Qinghai, Tibet, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and others. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in California, USA (DriveEasy Inc.), indicating some international presence. Its service network covers nationwide urban and regional markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shijihengtong functions mainly as a midstream digital service integrator and platform operator. It aggregates and manages service providers (small merchants) and delivers value-added digital services to large enterprise clients and end consumers. The company does not manufacture physical products but provides technology-enabled service platforms and operational support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation and intelligent service innovation, focusing on upgrading vehicle owner services, expanding smart parking and digital driving test platforms, and enhancing life information service ecosystems. R&D efforts emphasize big data fusion, AI-driven decision-making, federated learning for secure data collaboration, and intelligent business process automation. It aims to deepen multi-scenario applications and accelerate technology commercialization to strengthen competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees from vehicle owner information services, life information services, and business process outsourcing. The company employs usage-based pricing, revenue sharing with clients, and subscription or contract-based models. It also earns income from government subsidies and occasional investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading digital life service provider in China’s internet and automotive aftermarket sectors. It competes with other digital service platforms and technology firms serving telecom operators, financial institutions, and automotive service ecosystems. Its strong client base, extensive merchant network, and proprietary technology provide a competitive edge in the digital lifestyle and vehicle services market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, a 13.25% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 61.9 million, a 23.55% decrease year-over-year. Total assets grew by 25.89% to RMB 2.3 billion. The company is in a growth phase with expanding revenue but experiencing short-term profit fluctuations due to increased strategic investments and operational costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shijihengtong offers a comprehensive, integrated digital service platform connecting large enterprises, merchants, and consumers, delivering personalized, intelligent, and convenient vehicle and lifestyle services. Its proprietary technology platform enables scalable, customizable solutions with strong data security and operational efficiency. The company emphasizes service quality, broad coverage, and innovative digital rights management to differentiate itself in the competitive digital life service market.
